assets.name: glasses
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent overlay sprite for a simple friendly flat 2D avatar customizer. Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY; do NOT recreate the UI or character. Match its restrained hand-cut vector-like illustration: matte flat fills, clean soft edges, tiny darker color plane for form, no texture, no outlines except where requested, no 3D, no glossy plastic. Draw ONLY the specified isolated accessory centered with generous transparent padding. No text, character, face, eyes, UI, drop shadow, background, checkerboard or extra items. Real transparent alpha.
Subject: One pair of perfectly FRONT-VIEW round eyeglasses, two large symmetrical circular frames, a short curved bridge and short outward horizontal arms. Thin muted dusty plum #79718f frame. Frame width 3% of full glasses width. Completely transparent empty lens holes; absolutely NO eyes, white filling, reflections or opaque lenses. Overall width to height about 2.4:1.
assets.normalizations: Deterministic crop to alpha > 8 plus 2 px padding; resize fit within 600x600; WebP quality95 alpha100. No recoloring.
